name: Review
description: Single customer review card in the #reviews marquee rail. The rail's aggregate numbers (4.8 / 8,000+ / 12 lakh+) are section settings, not metaobjects - they have no native platform source.

field_definitions.name: Product label
field_definitions.description: Product line on the card, e.g. "Laundry detergent". A free-text label so marketing can write anything.

field_definitions.name: Rating
field_definitions.description: Star rating rendered as filled stars (1-5).

field_definitions.name: Headline
field_definitions.description: Short headline, e.g. "Works like a charm".

field_definitions.name: Verified
field_definitions.description: Shows the verified-purchase check on the card.
